messages:
incident-bot: @here Incident: Elevated error rate and truncated streams in Hosted API (eu-west-2) observed at ~09:33 UTC. Marking P2. status.redwood.ai/incidents/1798129999 :warning:

ops-oncall: Seeing spike in 5xxs and streaming truncations tied to a misconfigured route that disabled the stream-fallback.

nina: Confirmed root cause: config flag stream_fallback=false rolled out in last edge deploy. Rolling a hotfix to re-enable fallback and throttle noisy clients.

support: We have five customer reports; CS drafting heads-up and will post once mitigation is verified.

deploy-bot: hotfix deploy started by nina:edge/fix-stream-fallback -> canary at 09:44 UTC

ops-oncall: Canary shows errors drop immediately; staged rollout in progress. Also applying short-term per-ip concurrent cap of 8 for anonymous routes.

nina: Hotfix fully rolled out at 10:03 UTC. 5xxs down to baseline and truncated streams resolved. Keeping caps for 20m as buffer.

support: Customer note posted: intranet.redwood.ai/cs/1798129999-note. Follow-up RCA will be published in ~48h.

incident-bot: Status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Public page: status.redwood.ai/incidents/1798129999 (internal draft at intranet.redwood.ai/incidents/1798129999)

ops-oncall: Closing live thread. Ping me if anything reappears. :thumbsup:
